facts.text: The image is a vertical character reference sheet: a large cinematic hero image occupies the top, three full-body turnaround views are in the middle row, and four close-up detail panels are across the bottom.

The top hero panel shows an adult standing on a wet, reflective elevated urban walkway or rooftop platform at night; metal railings line both sides, rain streaks are visible, and blurred city lights and building facades fill the background.
In the hero panel, the adult wears a dark tactical outfit and stands with a slightly wide stance, one foot forward, head turned to one side and looking off-camera.
The person has short dark hair that is shaved at the sides and gathered into a small topknot at the back of the head.
The outfit consists of a black or charcoal high-collared tactical jacket with chest straps and metal buckle hardware, a dark undershirt, dark cargo trousers, and black combat boots.
The front full-body panel shows the person facing forward with arms relaxed at the sides against a dark, plain studio-like backdrop.
The side-profile panel shows a standing profile view with the topknot, jacket silhouette, cargo trousers and boots visible.
The back panel shows the rear of the jacket, trousers and boots, with the topknot visible.
The face close-up shows a neutral, serious expression, direct gaze toward the camera, and a visible small scar near one eyebrow/upper forehead.
The jacket-collar close-up shows the high collar, dark fabric texture, a diagonal strap and a metal buckle across the shoulder/collar area.
The hands close-up shows two hands with relaxed, slightly curled fingers and visible skin texture and veins.
The boots close-up shows black lace-up combat boots with worn leather, laces and rugged soles.
Lighting is dark and moody: the hero scene uses cool blue-gray ambient light with warm amber city-light bokeh, while the turnaround and detail panels use soft low-key studio lighting.
On-screen labels appear beneath the panels in white uppercase text: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, BOOTS.

card.summary: A photorealistic character reference sheet for an adult in dark tactical clothing, featuring a cinematic rainy-night hero shot plus front, side-profile, back, face, jacket-collar, hands and boots panels.
